Subject: Activation script and role timemap — Solstice MAP & launch cadence

Hi Ava / Carlos,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Attached is an initial "activation script" I sketched that translates the Mutual Action Plan we discussed into week-by-week checkpoints, owners, and clear acceptance criteria. The goal here is to get to a 10-week go-live runway that aligns with your internal change freeze on 2027-03-01.

High-level asks from our side:
- Please confirm the week-zero start date that works for you (proposal below).
- Confirm the primary owner for technical validation and the primary PM who will sign off on acceptance criteria.
- Any blackout dates or org-wide freezes between Feb 1–Mar 1.

Proposed start: Monday 2027-01-03 (10 weeks to target go-live 2027-03-13). If you need an earlier start we can compress tasks but that will affect testing windows.

Key attached items:
- solstice_activation_script_v0.1.xlsx — sprint-by-sprint checklist (owners, deliverables, exit criteria).
- role_timemap_v2.pdf — recommendation for who at Solstice & Redwood leads each lane (integration, data, security, success).

Internal note: Marcus and Naomi, I'm looping you for CS assignment and to confirm availability for the technical deep-dive during week 2.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Ava/Carlos confirm start date and owners by EOD Friday 2026-12-18.
2) We lock a recurring 30-minute weekly cadence (Wednesdays) for the PM/technical sync.
3) Week 0: provisioning + test account + data onboarding checklist.

Happy to jump on a quick call if you'd prefer to walk through the sheet together.

Best,
Jordan Blake

jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for this — the sheet is helpful and gives a clean view of sequencing. A few quick notes from our side:
- Proposed start is fine: we can do Monday 2027-01-03 but would like the option to slide a week earlier if we can get the security review completed this month.
- Primary technical owner: Carlos Mendez (cc'd).
- Product/PM owner: Liam O'Connor (cc'd). He'll own acceptance for feature parity and UAT sign-off.
- Blackout: we have an internal marketing freeze the week of 2027-02-14; that means we need testing wrapped before then or plan a staggered rollout.

Questions:
1) Can Redwood commit to a staging environment with red-team logging enabled by Week 3? We need that for a vendor security review.
2) Is there an estimated token cost range for a UAT window of ~50k tokens/day? We need that for procurement planning.

I'll confirm owners formally by Friday. We can do the weekly Wednesday check-in — 9am PT works for us.

Thanks,
Ava Patel
Director of Product | Solstice Health
ava.patel@solstice-health.com
